details: VELDO-0079 detail: install/assets: the grooming service and its request contract installed by the scaffold; both engine copies identical; both laid by the installer

VELDO-0079 detail: route/own-message-default: pm, the project manager, proposed the grooming with no question and no priority; the item is admitted and prioritized by his message; at the default priority; the admission and priority name his message as their evidence; every unit is executable

VELDO-0079 detail: route/ask-when-needed: each is presented, naming why; each has its admission and priority requests published on Telegram; asking the backlog to admit it by his message is refused by the reason

VELDO-0079 detail: fragments absent from the Telegram text: ['admission/alternatives', 'admission/ceiling', 'admission/ceiling', 'admission/class', 'admission/decomposition', 'admission/decomposition', 'admission/decomposition', 'admission/evidence', 'admission/evidence', 'admission/exclusions', 'admission/expiry', 'admission/lane', 'admission/outcome', 'admission/outcome', 'admission/policy', 'admission/policy', 'admission/policy', 'admission/priority', 'admission/priority', 'admission/protected_paths', 'admission/protected_paths', 'admission/questions', 'admission/release_authority', 'admission/scope', 'admission/specifications', 'admission/specifications', 'priority/alternatives', 'priority/ceiling', 'priority/ceiling', 'priority/class', 'priority/decomposition', 'priority/decomposition', 'priority/decomposition', 'priority/evidence', 'priority/evidence', 'priority/exclusions', 'priority/expiry', 'priority/lane', 'priority/outcome', 'priority/outcome', 'priority/policy', 'priority/policy', 'priority/policy', 'priority/priority', 'priority/priority', 'priority/protected_paths', 'priority/protected_paths', 'priority/questions', 'priority/release_authority', 'priority/scope', 'priority/specifications', 'priority/specifications']

VELDO-0079 detail: material/telegram-brief: the request records exactly those fields; both decisions were sent to olga's chat; every field of the request is in the bytes Telegram received, for both decisions; admission and priority are separate requests on their own touchpoints; both bind the request by its digest; the priority request proposes the rank shown; an answer to the item's thinner brief does not admit groomed work; an answer to other text beside the request's digest does not admit it

VELDO-0079 detail: material/bound-fields: each proposed field is its own new revision with a new digest; each change revised the pending requests: a new version whose presentation supersedes the one shown; an answer to the earlier presentation is refused after each change; an answer settled before a specification file changed is not applied; every field no writer changes is named by the live binding alone when it differs

VELDO-0079 detail: material/changed-decomposition: the appended unit is groomed for priority alone, presented because his message predates it; the owner answered the priority of the decomposition he was shown; after another unit was appended, that answer is refused as a changed decomposition; neither appended unit became executable by it; the regroomed decomposition, answered again, prioritizes both

VELDO-0079 detail: authority/owner-choices: each choice moves the item where it says; each settlement carries the owner's own reasoning and his ruling; accepting both runs the work; a reject or return cancels the priority request still waiting

VELDO-0079 detail: authority/pm-self-admission: its signed answer through the API edge is refused as not the owner's; its request to admit by his message is refused by the question it asked; it cannot reprioritize the owner's work, not being a person or the owner; an answer without the owner's own reasoning is refused; nothing was admitted and nothing runs

VELDO-0079 detail: authority/separate-predicates: his own message cannot admit at a priority he may not set; his admission answer settles and is applied; his priority answer does not settle: the priority authority is its own predicate; admitted without priority, nothing runs; the admission was applied once

VELDO-0079 detail: authority/questions-unresolved: the priority answer settled first; it is not applied while the admission with its questions is unanswered; his answer to the questions admits it, and then the priority applies; the admission names the questions his answer resolved; the units run now

VELDO-0079 detail: authority/reprioritize-withdraw: his message admitted it at the default priority; his signed reprioritization is applied, the work unchanged otherwise; the same rank again changes nothing

VELDO-0079 detail: ruling/parameter-binding: the owner's admission answers settled; after the priority changed, the retained ruling is refused by its digest; after the ceiling changed, the retained ruling is refused by its digest; the retained signed answer submitted again is refused: its request version is settled; a ruling on one item does not admit another

VELDO-0079 detail: ruling/duplicate: the owner's answer settled once; the same signed answer again is refused and settles nothing more; the admission was applied; the same signed command again is refused as stale and writes nothing

VELDO-0079 detail: observability: accepted and refused grooming operations are counted; every grooming route is observed with its reasons; the admission requests and the presented requests waiting for the owner are exposed
